# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Men, the alarm goes off and the battle begins. Before your feet hit the floor, the enemy is already whispering that you're not enough—not strong enough for the day's demands, not faithful enough for the calling God placed on your life. Joshua heard those same whispers. He was stepping into Moses' shoes, facing giants and walled cities, and God's first word to him wasn't a strategy—it was a command: be strong and courageous.

Notice the foundation of that courage. It isn't your bench press, your resume, or your willpower. It's the presence of God. "The LORD your God is with you wherever you go." Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of fear because you know who walks beside you. Strength isn't built in comfort—it's forged in the daily decision to show up, to lead, to pray, to resist temptation when no one is watching. Today, you will face something that tests you. Meet it not with bravado, but with the quiet confidence that God Himself goes before you.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups—on the last rep, hold the plank and thank God out loud that He is with you today. Then name one fear you're handing to Him.
